drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is Delmar’s proposed first-round revision. We have clarified the payment mechanics and proposed a broader release effective upon payment, while adding customary permitted-disclosure exceptions to the confidentiality provision. Please provide the agreed Settlement Amount and any comments on the proposed language.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. In consideration of the release set forth in this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [Settlement Amount] (the “Settlement Amount”) within [number] business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. The Settlement Amount is inclusive of all amounts payable by Defendant under this Agreement. Plaintiff shall provide any reasonably necessary payment instructions and tax documentation.
edits.name: 1. PAYMENT

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives, irrevocably releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, and obligations, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to any act, omission, or event occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not release either party’s obligations under this Agreement.
edits.name: 2. RELEASE

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and the negotiations leading to it, and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations; as reasonably necessary for tax, accounting, or insurance purposes; to enforce this Agreement; or as required by law, regulation, or court order. Where legally permitted, a party required to make a disclosure shall give the other party reasonable advance notice and reasonably cooperate, at the other party’s expense, in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this Section prohibits a party from making a disclosure protected by applicable law.
edits.name: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY
